en: The postcard shows a black and white photograph of a lush garden scene with palm trees, manicured bushes, and pathways with benches and stairs. The top right corner of the front side reads: 'Bad Pyrmont, Palmengarten'. The reverse side includes a German postage stamp from the Deutsches Reich era, printed German text, the logo of a local museum, and a remark about the beauty of the garden park.
